timing.summary: The old harness satisfies the former matrix operator API but cannot compile against the new scalar operator API.

coverage_evidence.dependency_reason: The build recipe compiles the fixed old harness against zlib.h.

claims.necessity_reason: The changed public signatures conflict with unconditional calls in the target, preventing compilation.

before.requirement: Provide a 32-element z_crc_t operator array to crc32_combine_gen(op, len2), then pass that array to crc32_combine_op.
before.reason: The old harness allocates the required array and uses the former generator and operator signatures.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The former implementation accepts the array and length.
The former operator implementation accepts the array pointer.

after.requirement: Use the uLong returned by crc32_combine_gen(len2) as the scalar operator passed to crc32_combine_op.
after.reason: The fixed old harness passes two arguments to the one-argument generator and passes an array to the scalar operator.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The changed implementation returns the scalar operator.
The changed operator implementation takes a scalar.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe compiles this source against the selected header.

claims.comparison_reason: The same CRC combine operation is compatible before and incompatible after because its operator representation changed.
